recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If maintainers want the stale SVG title updated, regenerate diagrams through the normal build process rather than hand-editing the SVG in this reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-48864 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asks to update NutritionProduct.biologicalSourceEvent to state that it is an identifier of the donation, collection, or pooling event from which biological material in this nutrition product was derived.
initial_application: Commit d0f9f0cb921ca73af9137792711cb1d73df8e5c1 updated source/nutritionproduct/structuredefinition-NutritionProduct.xml for FHIR-48864, changing the biologicalSourceEvent short and definition from the older traceability wording to the requested wording.
additional_context: NutritionProduct is active in source/fhir.ini. OO minutes show FHIR-48864 was created from the same biologicalSourceEvent wording discussion as Device FHIR-47890 and then approved 9-0-0 on 2024-11-25. Related Device and BiologicallyDerivedProduct issues are separate artifacts and were not decided in this seed. The only remaining NutritionProduct mismatch found is a checked-in SVG title with stale wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative XML source already satisfies the Jira request. The stale nutritionproduct.svg title was not edited because it is a generated-looking diagram artifact and the workflow forbids source-changing commits whose only hunk is such an artifact.

related_jiras.note: Device biologicalSourceEvent wording prompted creation of FHIR-48864, but it concerns a separate Device artifact.
